title: Plus One
summary: Given an array of digits representing a large integer, increment the integer by one and return the resulting array of digits.
statement: Given an array of digits representing a large integer, increment the integer by one and return the resulting array of digits.
constraints: The array contains 1–100 decimal digits, most significant first.
No leading zero occurs except for the number zero.
hints: Incrementing may propagate a carry left through several nines.
Work from the least significant digit toward the front.
If a digit is below nine, increment and return. Otherwise set it to zero and continue. If all carry, prepend one.
Only an all-nine input needs a longer output.
editorial: Scan from right to left. A digit below nine absorbs the increment and ends the work. A nine becomes zero and propagates the increment to its left neighbor. If every digit was nine, the result is a leading one followed by those zeros. The reference copies the input so the returned digits do not alter it.

tests.explanation: 99 + 1 = 100, so carrying creates an additional leading digit.
